description: Search FundingTracker's public directory of merchant cash advance and business financing providers by name, description or financing type (e.g. MCA, Term Loan, SBA Loan, Line of Credit). Filter by min_max_deal (largest deal at least this many USD), payments (daily, weekly or monthly) and works_with_isos. Returns each funder's slug, profile link, merchant review rating and its listed facts: type (direct funder or broker), max deal, payment schedules, ISO brokers and states.

financing_type.description: Filter by financing type, e.g. 'MCA', 'Term Loan', 'SBA Loan', 'Line of Credit'.

min_max_deal.description: Only funders whose max deal is at least this many USD, e.g. 250000. Funders that haven't listed a max deal are left out.

payments.description: Only funders offering this payment schedule: 'daily', 'weekly' or 'monthly'.

query.description: Words to match in the funder name or description. Omit to list the directory.

works_with_isos.description: true: only funders that work with ISO brokers; false: only those that don't.

name: search_funders
title: Search the funder directory
